line_item_status.name: line_item_status

updated_timestamp.name: updated_timestamp

clicks.name: clicks

impressions.name: impressions

metadata.name: twitter_ads__url_report
metadata.comment: Each record in this table represents the daily performance of ads at the account, campaign, line item (ad group), promoted tweet, and url level, within a placement in Twitter.

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.comment: The source of the record if the unioning functionality is being used. If not this field will be empty.

placement.name: placement
placement.comment: Where on Twitter the ad is being displayed. Possible values include 'ALL_ON_TWITTER', 'PUBLISHER_NETWORK', 'TWITTER_PROFILE', 'TWITTER_SEARCH', 'TWITTER_TIMELINE', and 'TAP_*', which are more granular options for `PUBLISHER_NETWORK`.
